kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 158.48 = the DRHP's listed-peer average P/E (28.10x, p. 155) applied to FY26 EPS Rs 5.64 (p. 154). Illustrative only: not a price band and not proposed by the issuer. The last share issue (Oct-2025, Rs 1,547 per Rs 10 share, about Rs 33.63 adjusted for the 22:1 bonus and 2:1 split) was a payment for promoter proprietorships, not a market price (pp. 105-106).

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: FY26 CFO Rs 26.85 m against PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%). Inventory +Rs 445.46 m and other assets +Rs 281.35 m absorbed the cash; receivables released Rs 242.66 m. Cumulative FY24-26 CFO Rs 281.93 m against PAT Rs 404.39 m (69.7%); FY24-25 CFO is standalone and was funded by payables to the promoters' proprietorships (Rs 160.70 m and Rs 259.02 m payables increase).

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Promoter advances outstanding Rs 45.00 m (Jagatjit Singh) and Rs 10.00 m (Dharam Singh); the Dehlon plant (16.20 acres) is leased from Jagatjit Singh at Rs 0.08 m a month and Rs 716.64 m of proceeds expand it. FY24-25 standalone purchases from the two proprietorships were Rs 420 m / Rs 256 m of Rs 735.68 m / Rs 462.13 m cost of materials.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top customer 25.21% and top-10 50.04% of FY26 revenue (top-5 40.84%); top-3 products 64.40%; Northern states 68.04% and Central 25.95%. Top-10 suppliers 40.53% of raw material cost, no long-term supply agreements.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: Promoters Jagatjit Singh and Dharam Singh were appointed directors on 29-Sep-2020 while disqualified (to 31-Oct-2021) over Jaggatjit Agro Pvt Ltd; adjudication application filed 11-Sep-2026, pending. The issuer attributes it to conflicting MCA records. Not a current disqualification.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: Audit trail at database level was not enabled in the accounting software until January 2026.

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: Offer is under Reg 6(2): the issuer fails Reg 6(1)(a) and (c) (net tangible assets and net worth tests), so at least 75% must go to QIBs or the offer fails.

focus.title: Firm means of finance
focus.detail: Rs 1,100 m (36.7% of gross) funds working capital and Rs 185 m repays debt; a monitoring agency is named (p. 11).

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -47.3% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

strengths: Third-largest homegrown implement maker by FY26 revenue (issuer-paid report, p. 245)

RoCE 31.10% and interest cover 5.03x in FY26 (p. 158)

weaknesses: Top-3 products 64.40% and top customer 25.21% of FY26 revenue (pp. 23-24)
FY26 CFO Rs 26.85 m vs PAT Rs 313.90 m (p. 88)
Dealers partly on letters of intent, not agreements (p. 23)
opportunities: Farm equipment market 7.7% CAGR to FY30 (issuer-paid report, p. 205)

threats: Seasonal fourth quarter; Northern and Central states 93.99% of revenue (pp. 23, 34)
Group company Goodfield Technology has overlapping interests (p. 24)
